summary: Connect fiscal forecasts, expenditure ceilings and annual budgets through practical public-sector scenarios. Explore the course and strengthen your budget analy
lede: Medium-term fiscal framework and risk-management training helps public finance teams link forecasts, expenditure ceilings and annual budgets. Treasury officials, budget directors and planning officers practise documenting forecast assumptions, allocating multi-year ceilings, assessing fiscal risks and tracking budget credibility through public-sector scenarios and Excel-based exercises.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for public finance professionals who prepare, scrutinize or use multi-year fiscal projections, ministry ceilings, fiscal-risk disclosures and annual budget submissions.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with public-sector budgeting, budget submissions or fiscal forecasting is recommended. No programming is required; exercises use spreadsheet-based scenario analysis.
